# Spotlight

> Spotlight is a futuristic media marketing agency — where marketing meets intelligence. We combine sharp human strategy with AI-accelerated execution across digital marketing, PR, creative production, influencer marketing, brand strategy, and content automation.

Spotlight helps brands grow through full-funnel, data-driven marketing. Every campaign pairs human judgment with AI-assisted tooling, and every AI-drafted piece of content is reviewed and approved by a person before it ever goes live — nothing publishes on autopilot.

## Services

- **Digital Marketing** — Meta & Google Ads strategy and budget pacing, AI-assisted content calendars and copy (human-approved), always-on performance dashboards.
- **Public Relations** — Coverage and sentiment monitoring, journalist-beat matching, human-led media relationships.
- **Creative Production** — Multi-format asset resizing, AI-assisted rough cuts for short-form video, templated design systems.
- **Influencer Marketing** — Data-backed creator discovery, brief-to-approval deliverable tracking, performance-linked reporting.
- **Brand Strategy** — Positioning, brand voice guides (stored as structured, living data), identity systems for every channel.
- **Content & Automation** — Agentic AI and n8n-driven pipelines for Blog, News and Events, gated behind human approval; built for SEO, AEO, GEO and LLM discoverability from day one.

## Key facts

- Studio type: full-spectrum media marketing agency.
- Approach: Discover → Design → Deploy → Decode — a repeatable strategy-to-reporting loop.
- Guardrail: AI never auto-publishes client- or brand-facing content; every piece is human-reviewed first.
